```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[very thick, line cap = round]
    \def\Lx{8}
    \def\Ly{3}
    \def\kF{0.55*\Lx}
    \def\y{0.7*\Ly}
    \def\ang{50}

    \draw[->] (0,0) -- (\Lx,0) node[right] {$\abs{\vb{k}}$};
    \draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,\Ly) node[right] {$N(\vb{k})$};

    \draw[mydashed] (\kF,0) node[below] {$k_\text{F}$} -- (\kF,\Ly);
    \draw[mydashed] (\kF,0.6*\y) -- (0,0.6*\y) node[left] {$z_{k_\text{F}}$};

    \fill[mygrey, opacity=0.3] (0,\y) -- (0.7*\kF,\y) to[out=0, in=180-\ang] (\kF,0.6*\y) -- (\kF,0.35*\y) to[out=-\ang,in=180] (1.3*\kF,0) -- (0,0) -- cycle;
    \draw (0,\y) -- (0.7*\kF,\y) to[out=0, in=180-\ang] (\kF,0.6*\y) -- (\kF,0.35*\y) to[out=-\ang,in=180] (1.3*\kF,0);

    \draw[<-] (\kF,0.6*\y) --++ (45:0.1*\Lx) node[right, align=left] {\footnotesize Discontinuity \\ \footnotesize in $N(\vb{k})$ at $T=0$};

\end{tikzpicture}
```
